question_text: Calculate the fraction of solidification that occurs dendritically when iron nucleates (a) at $10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ undercooling; (b) at $100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ undercooling; and (c) homogeneously. The specific heat of iron is $5.78 \mathrm{~J} /\left(\mathrm{cm}^3 .{ }^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$. Give your answer as a tuple: (fraction_at_10C_undercooling, fraction_at_100C_undercooling, fraction_homogeneously).The units of each required answer are (, , ), respectively.
response:
## Solution

**Physical reasoning:** When undercooled liquid iron nucleates, dendritic solidification begins, releasing latent heat. This heat raises the system temperature back toward the melting point $T_m$. Only the fraction that solidifies *before* recalescence reaches $T_m$ occurs dendritically; the rest solidifies conventionally at $T_m$.

**Heat balance** (per unit volume):

$$f \cdot \Delta H_f = c_p \cdot \Delta T \quad \Longrightarrow \quad f = \frac{c_p \,\Delta T}{\Delta H_f}$$

**Iron properties** (Kurz & Fisher, *Fundamentals of Solidification* — source of the given $c_p = 5.78$ J/(cm³·°C)):

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| $c_p$ | 5.78 J/(cm³·°C) |
| $\Delta H_f$ | 2480 J/cm³ |
| $T_m$ | 1811 K |
| $\Delta T_{\text{hom}}$ | $0.2\,T_m = 362.2$ K |

**Calculations:**

**(a)** $\Delta T = 10°$C:
$$f = \frac{5.78 \times 10}{2480} = \frac{57.8}{2480} = 0.0233$$

**(b)** $\Delta T = 100°$C:
$$f = \frac{5.78 \times 100}{2480} = \frac{578}{2480} = 0.2331$$

**(c)** Homogeneous nucleation ($\Delta T = 0.2 \times 1811 = 362.2$ K):
$$f = \frac{5.78 \times 362.2}{2480} = \frac{2093.5}{2480} = 0.8442$$

**Interpretation:**
- At only 10°C undercooling, recalescence quickly returns the system to $T_m$, so just ~2.3% solidifies dendritically.
- At 100°C undercooling, ~23% solidifies dendritically before recalescence.
- At the deep undercooling required for homogeneous nucleation (~362°C), ~84% of solidification is dendritic — most of the sample freezes before the temperature can recover to $T_m$.

$$\boxed{(0.0233,\; 0.2331,\; 0.8442)}$$
